BiblicalUsage: A superscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS. The Greek text behind the King James Version reads the Latin word here, while the text I have checked carries no list of languages at this verse.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the title was written in three tongues because the King it named belongs to the whole world.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
